text:
noah: Observed a weird reconnection pattern after rolling proxy v6 to edge-3. Clients reconnecting twice within 1s sometimes, and resume tokens show up in two different sessions. Not seeing 204s this time.

rachael: Logs? My hunch is keepalive/heartbeat jitter between the proxy and upstream router. Could be two proxies with slightly different lease timers racing and both thinking they own session.

noah: Example snippet (redacted):
```
edge-3 | 2026-03-21T18:11:02Z INFO keepalive recv id=xyz lease=10s
router | 2026-03-21T18:11:03Z WARN lease-claim conflict token=rt-7a owner=edge-2
client | 2026-03-21T18:11:03Z INFO reconnect attempt=1 resume_id=rt-7a
edge-3 | 2026-03-21T18:11:03Z INFO accepted new session id=sess-44 resume_id=rt-7a
client | 2026-03-21T18:11:03Z INFO reconnect attempt=2 resume_id=rt-7a backoff=50ms
```

pritam: Hmm. Looks like edge-2 still thought it had the lease but edge-3 accepted reconnect and created a new session before the router could reconcile the tombstone. Leads to duplicate sessions for same resume token.

rachael: Are we seeing this across tenants or a specific shard? Dashboard: https://console/streams/leases shows a small blip on edge-3 around 18:10. But our dashboard smoothing hides bursts; the spike is only visible if you set resolution to 10s.

noah: Right now alerting is on 1m aggregated rate which blurred the twin-reconnects. We need a higher-res alert and a sticky dedupe at router-level for a short window.

pritam: Quick mitigation ideas: 1) Router-side dedupe: accept first reconnect for a resume token and drop duplicates within X ms (configurable). 2) Unify default keepalive TTL across proxies (we currently have 10s and 11s in different builds). 3) Emit a route tag 'lease.conflict=true' for traces so console can correlate tenant impacts.

rachael: Prefer 1+2 combined. Dedupe window could be 200ms to cover in-flight races. But need to ensure we don't drop legitimate fast reconnects from mobile clients. Maybe dedupe only for sessions that already have an active session on a different edge and where resume token was seen <= 2s ago.

noah: Agreed. Also need telemetry sampling bump for lease.conflict to capture full traces for a while. current sample is 0.25% which is useless.

alerts-bot: sampling.adjust requested by rachael: metric=lease_conflict.trace_rate -> 0.05 ; duration=1h ; roll=true

pritam: I'll throw a tiny router patch that implements the dedupe heuristic behind a feature flag router.dedupe_resume_fast_canary. Also a config sync to align keepalive TTLs to 10s across all proxies. Canary on edge-3 only.

noah: Can you also add a short log line when dedupe drops an event so we can metric it? e.g., "router dedupe drop token=rt-7a reason=fast-duplicate delta_ms=120"

pritam: Yep. And I'll increment the lease_conflict metric when that happens.

rachael: Console needs a new column in the route timeline: lease.conflict and a filter to show affected tenant ids. console-bot can you add that and a drilldown to raw traces?

console-bot: Acknowledged. Adding column lease.conflict and drill link. Will default to hidden and enable for oncall role.

noah: Canary deployed to edge-3, dedupe flag on. Watching metrics.

pritam: Patch: router/patch-dedupe-resume canary=edge-3 flag=router.dedupe_resume_fast_canary window_ms=200

rachael: Early telemetry shows duplicate-accepts down by ~90% on that edge after patch. We still saw a couple of edge cases where mobile client rapid reconnects were dropped, so I increased the allowed delta to 350ms for client-type=mobile.

noah: Nice. Any follow-ups?

pritam: Follow-ups: 1) Roll flag to other edges after 2h successful canary. 2) Make keepalive TTL config central and enforce via infra rollout. 3) Add a permanent route event tag lease.conflict_reason with values like edge-mismatch, late-tombstone, proxy-keepalive-drift. 4) Add high-res alert: duplicate_session_rate > 0.1% in 5m at 10s resolution -> page.

rachael: And update runbook: how to debug lease conflicts (logs to check, queries to run). I'll draft doc and link in console trace.

noah: Ok wrapping up: canary looks good after 37m, duplicate sessions collapsed. Leaving sampling at 5% for 1h then revert to 0.25%. Thanks all. :tada:
